_readme: Synthetic knowledge pack for the enquiry-assistant demo. Brightwater Plumbing is a made-up business; prices and details are invented. Not connected to Brain or any client data.

entries.title: Services
entries.text: Brightwater fixes leaking taps, blocked drains, toilets and hot water systems for homes and small businesses.

entries.title: Service area
entries.text: We cover Canberra and Queanbeyan. Travel outside that area is quoted separately.

entries.title: Hours
entries.text: Office hours are 7am to 5pm, Monday to Friday. Urgent weekend call-outs are available at an after-hours rate, confirmed by a person.

entries.title: Call-out fee
entries.text: A standard weekday call-out is $120, including the first 30 minutes on site. Parts are extra and quoted before work starts.

entries.title: Booking
entries.text: To book, share your suburb, the problem and a good time. A person confirms every booking; this assistant can't book jobs itself.

entries.title: Burst pipes
entries.text: For a burst pipe, turn the water off at the meter if you can, then tell us it's urgent so a person can call you back.
